artifacts.summary: Literature-grounded research report on modal representation theorems for the bimodal TM system: corpus inventory and acquisition table, Jonsson-Tarski vs. topological duality analysis, Sahlqvist classification of TM's axioms, diagnosis of the Spherical obstruction as a discrete-vs-topological duality mismatch, a 12-element proposed structure for the revised section, and 9 risks.

memory_candidates.content: literature-search.sh is FTS5-backed and AND-s every term: queries longer than 2-4 words reliably return zero hits. Always search the corpus with SHORT queries ('Jonsson Tarski', 'tense algebra', 'canonical extension'), never with a sentence.

The literature conversion quality gate rejects many otherwise-clean math PDFs on two marginal signals: 'sentence-boundary-glue' (whose benign journal-abbreviation class, e.g. 'Theor.Comp.Sci.', is deliberately unexempted) and zero-tolerance NUL/control characters (which for LaTeX-produced PDFs are almost always unmapped CMEX size-graded delimiters: 0x00/0x10/0x12 = '(' and 0x01/0x11/0x13 = ')', plus picture-environment line glyphs 0x02/0x0E/0x1B). The documented remedy of reconverting with LITERATURE_CONVERTER=fallback removes the genuine <sup>-span fusion corruption but not the delimiter glyphs. Workflow that works: convert with the fallback engine, inspect every gate hit individually, apply a determinate context-verified character repair, re-run literature_quality_gate.py directly, then install via literature-chunk.sh + a hand-written index.json entry carrying a conversion_note, and rebuild with literature-build-index.sh --global.

Registering a global-corpus document into a repo's specs/literature-index.json is a plain JSON append: {doc_id, reason, added, source, citation_rule, optional fidelity}, then bump .updated. No script is required and literature-build-index.sh is only needed when chunk files change, not when sub-index metadata changes. The sub-index doc_id must match the global index entry's id, which for a chunked book is the per-section id (e.g. blackburn_2002_ch05_sec04), not the book-level id.

errors.message: literature-discover.sh Tier 3 (Semantic Scholar) returned HTTP 429 on every attempt across the whole session (20+ attempts, 3 queries, 75s backoff, ~35 minutes). No automated discovery record was produced for any absent source, so nothing could be passed to literature-ingest-online.sh by the normal route.
errors.recommendation: Re-run `/literature <query>` or literature-discover.sh once Semantic Scholar recovers, targeting: Sambin & Vaccaro 1988 'Topology and duality in modal logic'; S. K. Thomason 1972 'Semantic analysis of tense logics' and 1975 'Categories of frames for modal logic'; Goldblatt 1976 'Metamathematics of modal logic' I-II; Fine 1975 'Some connections between elementary and modal logic'; Gehrke & Jonsson 2004 'Bounded distributive lattice expansions'; Gabbay & Shehtman 'Products of modal logics I'.

errors.message: literature-ingest-online.sh emitted ONLINE_INGEST_PIPELINE_FAILED for Venema 2007 (conversion quality gate) and ONLINE_INGEST_ZOTERO_CREATE_FAILED for Gehrke & Vosmaer (zotero-write.sh item-add rejects a record carrying no DOI). Both documents were installed into the corpus manually instead, with documented conversion repairs; both are searchable and registered.
errors.recommendation: The zotero-write.sh no-DOI failure is a reproducible bridge limitation worth a separate fix: an arXiv-only open_access record has an arxiv_id but no DOI, and item-add rejects it. Consider passing the published DOI when one exists (10.1007/978-3-642-22303-7_6 for Gehrke & Vosmaer).
